dedupe_keys.name: emma the european electricity market model

description: EMMA (The European Electricity Market Model) is an open energy model listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Open Models", published or maintained by Neon Neue Energieökonomik GmbH. Coverage: France, Poland, Belgium, The Netherlands, Germany, Sweden, Norway. The fact sheet classes it as: Power market model. Sectors: Electricity. Resolution: time Hour, geography Countries. Data availability is given as "all". The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0 (as given on the fact sheet). Caveats: this record was written from the openmod wiki fact sheet, which was read; the source code and documentation were not opened, and the sheet may be out of date (it carries no update date). It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
